svg.text: SmartAI Pro — Full System Architecture Blueprint
E:\smartpro2zglm\app · version 21.35.7 · 3 trading desks · 1 crypto signal engine · CoinDCX futures live execution
A · OS PROCESSES (what runs on the machine)
B · MARKET DATA HUB (stream clients → liveFeed → SSE)
C · API ROUTE SURFACE (all registered on the single Express app, gated by APP_PIN cookie)
signals · mtf-board · mtf-dual · mtf-auto · orders · positions
D · CRYPTO SIGNAL ENGINE (server/ai/* — the core the desk trades off; detailed in blueprint-signal-engine.svg)
margin split → batch = 1 full trade risk
E · MCP DATA-AGENT MESH (server/mcp/agents/* → registry.js → mcp/mesh.js enrichment routes)
10 market-data agents (one per provider, keyed from .env)
alpaca · alphavantage · ccxt · coinapi · coingecko · finnhubAgent
registry.allCards() → which are authed vs honestly-absent (missing key)
F · FRONT-END (React + Vite → dist/ · App.tsx shell · PIN login · keyboard 1/2/3)
App.tsx: 3 lazy desks + per-desk ErrorBoundary + 12s reconnect
HTTPS /api/* (all desk UI → one Express app)
G · STATE ON DISK (server/data/*.json + config/ — the durable memory; NEVER touched by test runs)
bot.mjs → lib/{router, api, telegram, commands, config}
so @bot and the 3 desks share one brain
